resolutions.researcher_notes: No source found names an operator specifically for the Abu Gharadig-El Hamra pipeline (or the Abu Gharadig field generically, as opposed to the 'North East Abu Gharadig' block). The seed citation (Egypt Oil & Gas's March 2020 Western Desert report) does table this exact route ('Abu Gharadig-El Hamra: Abu Gharadig -> El Hamra, 140 km, 12/16in, 60,000 bbl/d') and separately says Apache is 'the main operator in the Western Desert ... through its JVs, Khalda Petroleum Co. and Qarun Petroleum Co.', while Apache's own 2004 EIA (MIGA) says 'Apache has become operator of all these areas except North East Abu Gharadig' -- i.e. Khalda/Apache operate the wider Abu Gharadig-basin concessions but NEAG specifically is excluded, and neither document states Khalda as the pipeline's or field's operator by name. That gap is too wide to bridge without fabricating the link, so left unresolved rather than citing either document for شركة خالدة للبترول (Khalda Petroleum Company).
